visual_synopsis: A mustached doctor in blue scrubs and glasses sits at his desk in a plain white consulting room, first fiddling with a small mobile phone, then seeing patients one after another: a heavyset man in a black Adidas jacket, and an old woman in a white curly wig, purple jacket and handbag (a male actor in drag) who comes in from the corridor. The whole sketch is seated back-and-forth consultation talk with the doctor leaning over his desk and the patients reacting.
